sql: SELECT CAST(v.vendor_id AS STRING) AS vendor_id, CAST(v.legal_name AS STRING) AS vendor_name, CAST(v.uei AS STRING) AS uei, e.legal_name AS usa_legal_name, e.address_line1 AS usa_address_line1, e.city_name AS usa_city, e.state_code AS usa_state, e.zip AS usa_zip, s.cik AS cik, s.legal_name AS edgar_legal_name, s.phone AS edgar_phone, s.ein AS edgar_ein, p.payment_item_count, p.total_exposure FROM payee_erp.vendor v LEFT JOIN (SELECT CAST(vendor_id AS STRING) AS vendor_id, COUNT(*) AS payment_item_count, SUM(CAST(amount_usd AS DECIMAL(18,2))) AS total_exposure FROM payee_erp.payment_run_item GROUP BY CAST(vendor_id AS STRING)) p ON p.vendor_id = CAST(v.vendor_id AS STRING) LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.registry_entity e ON e.uei = CAST(v.uei AS STRING) LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.sec_registrant s ON s.cik = CAST(v.registrant_cik AS STRING) WHERE CAST(v.vendor_id AS STRING) = 'V-10027' LIMIT 10
